plan.summary:
Startup no longer loads the zip library. `exportAll` in `src/export.ts` now loads `zip-lib` with a dynamic `import()` only when `zip` is true.

- The import happens inside the `if (zip)` branch.
- The non-zip export path does not load the library.
plan.riskRationale: One-line change that defers a module load. The call site stays the same. The top-level import must be removed for the benefit to apply; the diff shows one added line and one deleted line, but only the added line is in the hunk index.
plan.storyArc: The change moves the zip library load from startup to the moment a zip export runs. One topic covers it.

topics.title: Load zip-lib lazily inside exportAll
topics.narrativeBrief: How does exportAll now get zip-lib, and when is it loaded? Verify in the full source that the static top-level import was removed and that `default` is the right export to use as `Zip`.
